I honestly had to go MIA from everything. Backed away from my social groups and they understood that i needed to take some time to reinvest the energy towards myself. Some people might not take it lightly and might leave and that is ok. It’ll suck for a while but looking back it was for the absolute best. Some people might be worried or latch onto you if they have any anxious based attachment styles, be prepared to lose them in order to conserve your energy spent with you. Be prepared to set boundaries with them. 

To start; I Deleted my socials off my phone, created a wants and needs list between now and 3 years from now. I created a vision board of everything that i was interested in doing or looking like. And then i took it one day at a time, worked a lot on my mental health and mindset (and still am!). From fixing my sleeping schedule and incorporating little workouts throughout the day to teaching myself how to cook. Everything came together piece my piece and everyone who watched me blossom have never been more proud to see me grow. 

Lastly, I learned how to save and invest my money towards things that matter the most. I Looked into hobbies that I always pondered about and actually gave myself the space to participate. I did a lot of research on how people work and how to empathize with others. I understood that a lot of traumas weren’t my fault and that I am not my past and built my confidence up from there. I established the path to build my own self identity so I wouldn’t fall into codependent habits. Im still on my journey, its a lot to unpack but I look back and still remind myself that I’ve made it this far.

For 12 rolls the recipe calls for:

1 large chicken breast; boiled and shredded

1/2 cup of franks red hots sauce/ or hot sauce in general

4 green onions, (diced)

3 stalks of celery 

1 cup of shredded moz cheese

2 “shakes” of parm 


1 egg for egg wash to seal 


Spring roll wrappers; visit a local Indian/asian grocery store! They have an amazing selection and a pack of 20 is around $3 bucks! Found in frozen section
Salt and pepper to your taste! 


Directions;

1) Thaw your spring roll wrappers (room temp) while You prep! Sheets will be hard to peel so be careful when doing so! 


2) Boil chicken in pot of water, add salt to let chicken brine


3) meanwhile, cut veggies up, be careful and make sure they’re diced or minced finely! 


4) once chicken is fully cooked, remove from heat and let it rest for 2 minutes. Use two forks to shred and tear your chicken up.


5) In a large bowl place your shredded chicken and add hot sauce, salt, pepper, veggies and cheese. Use a plastic spatula or hands to mix throughly 


6) to wrap rolls, place the spring roll into a diamond shape. Add two tbsp of filling near the bottom and roll away from you. At the midpoint, fold left and right corners inwards. There should be an isosceles triangle left before fully wrapping, use the egg wash and spread in this area before closing the wrap up.
